records.title: Deep Learning Scaling is Predictable, Empirically
records.table_note: finding: Generalization error falls as a power law of training set size in machine translation, language modeling, image classification and speech recognition; limitation: Model size is tuned per data size; compute budget is not treated as the constraint
records.label: HNA+17

records.title: A Constructive Prediction of the Generalization Error Across Scales
records.table_note: finding: Proposes a joint functional form of generalization error in model size and data size that extrapolates across scales; limitation: Fits small-scale models; training time and compute allocation are not modelled
records.label: RRBS19a

records.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
records.table_note: finding: A 1.5B-parameter Transformer language model trained on WebText performs downstream tasks zero-shot; limitation: Gains with size are reported, but no rule for allocating compute between size and data
